AgentChatService: turn context and tool dispatch
|-- startTurn(): AgentChatPanel send/readCanvas -> captured ChatSession
|   |-- Own starting/reloading guards; reject overlapping turns
|   |-- Repeated requestId returns without starting another turn
|   |-- Clone canvasContext: canvas target plus numbered references
|   |   |-- Bind MappingChatMcpBinding with target and readOnly access
|   |   `-- ChatCanvasBindings captures active binding before first await
|   |-- Read Canvas uses shortContextForCanvas() as read_canvas toolOutput
|   |   `-- Ordinary send includes captured reference snapshots with text
|   `-- Save requestIds and session before issuing turn/start
|       `-- Lost HTTP response can be retried without a duplicate turn
|-- callBoundTool(): token -> chat -> captured tool-call context
|   |-- Require running turn, canvas tools and no tool reload
|   |-- Check saved tool inventory; capture settings, references and call ID
|   `-- dispatchTool(): gen-alternatives -> AgentChatService
|       `-- Other chat tools -> ChatDiagramTools.call()
|-- Supplied edits: ChatDiagramTools owns request preparation and run owners
|   |-- Key by chat ID + requestId; reject changed arguments
|   |-- prepare(): resolve reference OR nodeId against one canvas snapshot
|   |   |-- All operations must target the same canvas document
|   |   |-- Validate current diagram identity and baseRevisionId
|   |   `-- Selected nodes must form complete subtrees for subtree edits
|   |-- Pin expectedVersion; agent.submitDirect() receives supplied content
|   |   `-- DiagramBatchService owns atomic validation/application boundary
|   `-- Record runId owner; status/cancel checks conversation ownership
`-- Stream and questions: connection notifications -> session listeners
    |-- receive(): update items, turn state, deltas and token usage
    `-- Pending wire requests stay in AgentChatService.requests
        `-- answer(): match pending request, validate answer, respond
